issues.body: The new production path is still documented as "malicious-secure" and "malicious-with-abort", but the added witness demonstrates that auth_mul accepts a tampered second operand and creates a MAC consistent with the wrong product. This is not only a residual integrity gap in an unrelated intermediate: auth_secret_is_zero calls session.auth_mul(v, &auth_mask), placing its supposedly nonzero masking value in exactly that vulnerable second slot. Replacing that mask with a valid sharing of zero makes a nonzero recompose_diff produce an authenticated zero product, so the range proof can accept corrupted recovered bits. The final verdict MAC check cannot detect a wrong value whose MAC was adopted along the way. The honest-path tests and sampled first-operand tamper tests do not cover this adversarial composition.
issues.fix_hint: Do not route the public malicious-with-abort API through this chain until MacSession has multiplication-gate verification that binds both operands (the Chida-style fix already identified in the diff), with a real end-to-end adversarial test that tampers a second operand in the decomposition and the zero-test mask and proves the pipeline aborts. Until then, retain the previous production implementation/range bound or expose this only under an explicitly non-malicious research API; documentation caveats alone are insufficient.
issues.title: Production malicious path relies on a multiplication primitive known to adopt adversarial inputs

verdict.summary: The Rabbit arithmetic appears internally consistent for honest execution, and the full-width differential/range tests exercise the production path. However, this cannot ship as the production "malicious-secure"/"malicious-with-abort" path while its own witness proves that auth_mul accepts adversarial changes to second operands. That weakness reaches the load-bearing range check: auth_secret_is_zero multiplies the recomposition difference by an authenticated mask in the second operand slot, so a malicious party that substitutes a zero sharing there can make a nonzero difference open as zero with a consistent MAC. In combination with an adopted gate tamper that produces incorrect but MAC-consistent recovered bits, the range guard can be bypassed and an incorrect verdict can reach the final checked open. Merely documenting the limitation does not make the security contract sound.
